name: xdev
description: Local D2 supervised development with optional XMem V2.1 engineering memory and explicit project binding.

interface.longDescription: Install without a project, then explicitly bind approved work for preparation, preflight, bounded execution and independent Review and QA. Optional XMem V2.1 engineering context, public-outcome capture and read-only reconciliation require separate configuration. Release declarations, installed bytes and actual host adoption are checked separately.
defaultPrompt: Use XDev Local to inspect the current project binding and available permissions.
Help prepare this task and preflight its approved inputs before bounded development.
Show the current-version status and quality result of this XDev Job.
Use explicitly configured XMem V2.1 engineering memory for this approved task while preserving full conditions, sources and uncertainty.
